about: Mississippi Mills is a town in Lanark County, Ontario, amalgamating Almonte, Pakenham, and surrounding rural land along the Mississippi River (the Ontario river, not the U.S. one). Mill heritage, a limestone downtown in Almonte, and the Five Span Bridge at Pakenham define the municipality. About 14,000 people live in Mississippi Mills.
